LiangYuxuan/ffxiv-signin-helper.body:
# FFXIV SignIn Helper

Automated check-in script for FF14 China server-related activities

## Features

### 石之家 (Rising Stones)

- [x] Daily check-in
- [x] Claim check-in rewards
- [x] Post 5 comments on the [water thread](https://ff14risingstones.web.sdo.com/pc/index.html#/post/detail/9365)
- [x] Publish 5 posts and delete them

## Obtaining Cookies

The program tries to obtain Cookies from the following sources, in order:
  * `COOKIES` in `.env`
  * `COOKIES` environment variable
  * A configured [CookieCloud](https://github.com/easychen/CookieCloud) service
  * Contents of the `.cookies` file

### Getting Existing Cookies

Open the developer tools, select any `apiff14risingstones.web.sdo.com` request in the Network tab, then find Cookie in the request headers.

### Getting New Cookies

After logging into 石之家 with the same type of client, the old login session becomes invalid. Obtaining new Cookies will invalidate the old desktop client login session.

```bash
# Docker
docker run --name ffxiv rhyster/ffxiv-signin-helper:latest pnpm start:cookies && docker cp ffxiv:/usr/src/app/.cookies ffxiv.cookies && docker rm -f ffxiv
# Node
pnpm install
pnpm start:cookies
```

After completing login by scanning the QR code shown by 叨鱼 (Diaoyu), the tool will automatically write Cookies to the `.cookies` file.

### Configuring CookieCloud

Set the environment variables `COOKIE_CLOUD_URL`, `COOKIE_CLOUD_UUID`, and `COOKIE_CLOUD_KEY`, and add `sdo.com` to the domain keywords for sync.

## Configuration and Running

### Docker

```bash
vi .env
docker pull rhyster/ffxiv-signin-helper:latest
docker run --rm --env-file .env --name ffxiv rhyster/ffxiv-signin-helper:latest
```

### Node

1. Runtime environment

Requires Node.js >= 20.10.0

2. Configuration

```bash
cp .env.example .env
vi .env
```

Edit according to the comments. To disable a feature, leave its value after the equals sign empty or change it to 0.

3. Start running...

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
```

# ServerFS MCP

**Simplified Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/NTLx/ServerFS_MCP/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

**A secure, standards-first, scope-authorized MCP filesystem server, with optional support for native AI Agent delegation.**

It exposes only the directories you explicitly choose, and stays read-only by default. Restricted file modification, revision-based concurrency protection, bounded binary transfer, and structured Codex / Claude Code / Qoder native runtime or operator-configured ACP Agent delegation can be enabled on demand, only where needed.

**Current stable version: v0.19.0**

**v0.20.0: Implemented release candidate, not yet released.** Linux Streamable HTTP uses a single stateful endpoint, supporting both the legacy `2025-11-25` session lifecycle and modern `2026-07-28` per-request metadata. The pinned-source MCP conformance gate has been integrated. Linux OCI `server.json` / Registry metadata is in preview; OCI + Streamable HTTP installer interoperability is **not yet verified**. The Registry is not a prerequisite for running or installing ServerFS. See [v0.20.0 acceptance record](https://github.com/NTLx/ServerFS_MCP/blob/HEAD/docs/v0.20.0-release-acceptance-2026-10-22.md).

v0.19.0 adds a generic ACP v1 profile to Agent Bridge, coexisting with the native Codex, Claude Code, and Qoder runtimes. ACP profiles are configured by operators with an absolute executable path and a fixed argv; task calls cannot override command, argv, or env, and the ACP runtime requires `workspace-write`. ServerFS does not automatically install or trust Agents from the ACP Registry; Provider authentication remains managed by the Provider itself. Model discovery/override, elicitation, client filesystem, and terminal are not supported; capabilities are reported conservatively based only on measured results. Smith-106/bilibili-comment-deleter.body:
# Bilibili Batch Comment Deleter v2.2 (Fully Optimized Edition)

> **Current version 2.2.153** (when the same live stream or column appears more than once in history, it is counted only once). A comprehensive optimization of **performance / network / data / UX** built on v2.1 (a merge of three lineages). Upstream: Smith-106 v2.0 + WorkBuddy v1.2 + SXM v1.1 + experience from naaammme/bilibili-tools.

## Installation / Usage

Same as v2.1: create a new script in Tampermonkey → paste the full text → open any `*.bilibili.com` page and click 🗑️ at the bottom right. Three enumeration sources: AICU fetch / official history scan / offline JSON import. Four-dimensional filtering by keyword + source + type + time sorting. Before deletion, you can export a 💾JSON/CSV backup.

## v2.1 → v2.2 Change List

### Performance
1. **List event delegation**: inline checkboxes and jump buttons now use a single listener at the container level (previously 2 closures per row; 10k rows meant 20k listeners).
2. **Incremental rendering**: 150-item chunks are loaded via IntersectionObserver as you scroll. Large lists no longer freeze from full rendering (previously, 5000+ items rendered at once would hang the page).
3. **O(1) deduplication**: rpid is indexed with a `Set` (previously a full linear scan with `Array.some`, O(n²), roughly 50 million comparisons in the AICU 10k-comment scenario).

### Network Layer
4. **Unified request layer**: requests are serialized per host (preventing concurrent hammering of the API). GET requests get **automatic retries with exponential backoff** (with jitter) on network errors and HTTP 412/429/5xx. A Bilibili response body with `code=-412` is likewise recognized as risk control.
5. Inherited v2.1 fixes: deletion requests use absolute URLs + `@connect`, and do not hand-assemble cookies (HttpOnly SESSDATA is unreadable from script anyway, so it relies on TM to attach it automatically).

### Data and Safety
6. **Persistent processing log** (localStorage, capped at 2000 entries): each deletion result (success / failed / pending confirmation) is saved. When the same rpid appears later, it shows a badge `上次已删除✓ / 上次失败 / 上次待确认` (meaning "previously deleted ✓ / previously failed / previously pending confirmation"). Reopening the page does not lose the record.
7. **Export backup before deletion**: JSON / CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, opens directly in Excel).
8. **Account-switch protection**: when the enumerated list's UID differs from the currently logged-in UID, an explicit confirmation is shown before deletion. The delete API only acts on the currently logged-in account, so this prevents the mistaken belief that you're deleting another account's comments, and prevents accidental deletion across mixed data from two accounts.
9. **Exhausted consecutive -509 rate limiting**: explicitly counted as "not applied" (fixes v1.2's silent miscounting). Entries stopped midway are recorded as "pending confirmation," so no data is lost.

itrous/bsl-analyzer.description: BSL (1C:Enterprise) code analyzer with LSP support. Written in Rust.
itrous/bsl-analyzer.body:
# BSL Analyzer

Experimental Language Server for BSL (1C:Enterprise), written in Rust.

## Project idea

The project tests the hypothesis: what would a 1C developer get if the architecture of [rust-analyzer](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer) were applied to the 1C:Enterprise language: incremental computation on Salsa, full-fidelity CST on Rowan, multi-layer HIR with type inference, and flow-sensitive analysis via CFG and dataflow.

Practical effects of this architecture:

- **Incremental recomputation.** Salsa invalidates only the part of the query graph that depends on the edit, without reprocessing the whole project.
- **Semantic hover and completion.** Real type inference (HIR/Ty): `Документы.ПКО.<TAB>` is filtered by the receiver's type; hover shows the actual type of the expression, including unions from `ОписаниеТипов` and JSDoc. After `Если ТипЗнч(Х) = Тип("Массив")`, the type inside the branch is narrowed (narrowing).
- **Find references and rename by symbol.** Search works through `SemanticSymbol`, not a text grep, so local variables and module exports with the same name are not confused.
- **Flow-sensitive diagnostics.** Unreachable code, unused assignments, lost `Возврат`…

joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin Live Room Start/Stop Monitor

Automatically monitors a list of Douyin live rooms. As soon as a room goes live or ends its broadcast, a notification is pushed to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification opens the Douyin app directly to the corresponding live room using the Douyin URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`).

## How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream address?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Mark as live]
    E -- No --> G[Mark as offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with last state]
    H --> I[If state changed, send Bark]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Detection basis: the `liveStatus` field in Douyin's web SSR also returns `normal` for rooms that are currently live (unreliable). However, on offline room pages, the count of real stream addresses such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url` is 0, while live rooms have many. Therefore, "the page contains real stream addresses" is used as the reliable signal for being live. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent in that run (to prevent false positives).

## File Overview

- `monitor.py` — main program: reads rooms.txt, detects live status, sends Bark notifications, writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt` — the monitoring list. Only edit this file; there is no need to touch monitor.py.
- `state.json` — runtime state (last live status), maintained automatically by the program and added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1` — script for adding rooms from the local command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py` — Python version of the same functionality (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt Format

One room per line, in the form "link or identifier, display name", separated by a comma:

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, Teacher Zicheng Teaches Family Education
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, Yuchuan E-commerce

- The display name can be omitted (short links will automatically look up the nickname using sec_uid).
- Supported formats:
  - Numeric room ID / Douyin ID (username)
  - `live.douyin.com/房间号`
  - `v.douyin.com/xxxx`…

wimi321/lizzieyzy-next.body: Simplified Chinese · Traditional Chinese · English · Japanese · Korean · Thai Provides Fox nickname game-record fetching, fast whole-board analysis, a new winrate chart, and a quick overview bar at the bottom. Publishes builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux. · · · · > [!NOTE] > Users in mainland China are advised to download the official release from the [official download page](https://goagent.top/download/). For installers, Linux packages, or older versions, use [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wimi321/lizzieyzy-next/releases). > > Users in mainland China can also download from the public Baidu Netdisk: > [https://pan.baidu.com/s/1wthaL8YwGMxy_u0U7Mabpw?pwd=3i8w](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1wthaL8YwGMxy_u0U7Mabpw?pwd=3i8w) > Extraction code: `3i8w` > [!TIP] > [Project discussion QQ group: 299419120](https://qm.qq.com/q/JZoeojjteg) > > Feel free to discuss usage questions, report bugs, share your experience, or talk about the features you most want added next. ## What you can do right after opening it | What you want to do | How this project handles it now | | --- | --- | | Fetch recent public Fox game records | Enter a Fox nickname directly; the program automatically matches the account and fetches its games | | Quickly review the trend of a whole game | Provides fast whole-board analysis, so you don't have to rely entirely on stepping through moves by hand | | Quickly find problem moves | Provides the new main winrate chart and a bottom heatmap overview, making major mistakes easier to spot at a glance | | Reduce the impact of the quick curve on the main engine | In `KataGo one-click setup -> Weight management`, you can download the official 38 MB lightweight model on demand. It only starts when filling in the game-record curve, and it releases the GPU as soon as main analysis starts | | Less configuration hassle | The recommended bundle includes KataGo, default weights, and automatic configuration on first run | | Don't want to install | On Windows, the `portable.zip` no-install package is recommended by default | | Board synchronization | The main Windows release bundle includes the native `readboard.exe`, so the sync entry point is clearer | | Local compute is not enough | `Settings -> Remote Compute Center` lets you log in to Zhizi Cloud Compute (智子云算力).
